subject: Re: Acme Maps - Mutual Action Plan and Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Ellis <john.ellis@acmemaps.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acmemaps.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 17:15:00 -0800
Subject: Thanks for the call - recap & next steps

John / Sarah - great to meet both of you on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all stay aligned.

Key pain points you shared
- High latency on map tiling/vector generation at peak during routing queries (p95 > 1s).
- Cost of current inference infrastructure rising with 3x monthly growth in requests.
- Need for private deployment for certain datasets due to contractual restrictions.

Goals we heard
- Reduce p95 latency to ~200-300ms for critical routes.
- Cut per-token inference cost by ~40% through smarter batching + quantization.
- Ability to run inference in your VPC for sensitive datasets and audit logs.

What Redwood can deliver (high level)
- Dedicated GPU pool with latency SLOs and autoscale for peak mapping traffic.
- Prefix/KV caching and workload-aware batching tuned for short, repeated routing queries.
- Private deployment option (VPC) and SOC2 evidence to support procurement.

Immediate next steps
1) I will share a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones and owners by end of week (attached).
2) Michael to scope a short technical POC (2-3 weeks) to validate latency and cost claims.
3) John to confirm internal stakeholders for procurement and a target decision date.

Proposed timeline (prelim)
- Technical POC kickoff: week of Feb 23
- Procurement review & security questionnaire: Mar 9-20
- Pilot/POC complete: Mar 16
- Decision: end of March

Attachments: redwood-acme-map-MAP-v1.pdf - draft MAP with milestones and owners.

If I missed anything or you want different dates, tell me and I'll update. Thanks again - excited to partner.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Marissa - thanks for the clear summary. This matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- Stakeholders: Procurement lead is Sarah Patel (cc'd). Our Engineering lead on this is David Huang (david.huang@acmemaps.com) - can we add him to the MAP and POC?
- Decision timeline: leadership wants a recommended vendor by Mar 31, final approval by mid-April. Can the pilot/POC finish by Mar 20 instead of Mar 16? We have some flexibility if needed.

We'll review the attached MAP and get back with edits. Michael / Vivek - can you confirm availability for a technical kickoff the week of Feb 23?
